review_notes: Independently read the current proposal.json in full, functionality.md in full, and both disposition ledgers through their final pages. The reviewed proposal contains five supported writes, all for owned subjects, and no new links, entities, merges, or follow-ups.

Read both complete owned files in canonical and rendered form. Rendered substitutions were treated as hypotheses, not evidence. The static forward declaration establishes the entry helper's internal linkage; its omission from the header is consistent.

Validated the prerequisite, ABS macro, motion-change signature, grounding implementation, animation query, completion dispatcher, physics delegates, collision delegate, effect adapter, active motion table, and Damage/DamageIce consumers against canonical foreign source.

The five writes correctly distinguish unordered direction products, conditional grounding and ordered subsystem requests, directional rather than neutral-tech collision processing, friction scaling rather than proven stronger braking, and conditional completion destinations.

The active table assigns these callbacks to both PassiveStandF and PassiveStandB while assigning separate callbacks to Passive. Together with the facing-relative input selection and damage-recovery callers, this supports the directional-tech mapping without relying on numeric enum names.

Retained references to an applicable neutral state are broad dispatcher terminology, consistent with the canonical comment on ft_8008A348, not proof of universal Wait or ordinary idle. The retained detailed Anim state-behavior fact and the proposed TU correction explicitly preserve the boss, DownSpot, and special branches.

Accepted retention of request-consumption and audiovisual-purpose summaries does not establish input-bit clearing, unconditional asset realization, or downstream purity. Those stronger interpretations remain expressly deferred.

All three .sdata2 facts remain unresolved. Acceptance does not establish compiled layout, physical literal identity, register assignments, configured thresholds, asset meanings, or asynchronous lifetime contracts.

fact_dispositions.reason: The source uses zero and one, but does not identify their physical storage with this .sdata2 subject.
Neither owned file establishes an eight-byte section or two physical f32 objects. Compiled evidence is required.
Scalar parameter roles are supported, but attributing their provision to this compiled literal pool is not.
The prerequisite reads and subsequent input/facing-to-motion flow match the canonical definitions.
The ordinary directional mapping is corroborated by the actual selection, active callback table, and damage-recovery caller. Exceptional products are covered by the replacement state-behavior fact.
CheckInput is a reasonable inferred name for this state-changing boolean gate, not a canonical symbol or purity claim.
Signature and return convention are correct. False denotes absence of this gate's local entry dispatch; unrestricted downstream purity is not established.
The routine accepts and dispatches a directional recovery request. Consumes is not interpreted as clearing controller bits.
The supported proposed write includes unordered products in the B branch and limits failed-guard claims to local entry. Equality and signed-zero behavior follow the actual comparisons.
The caller-selected motion, Fighter resolution, ground-state test, sound-data read, and TopN argument are explicit. Ground normalization is confirmed independently.
The private entry helper receives the selected F/B motion from the directional gate, and the active table registers the corresponding recovery callbacks.
Enter describes the verified common entry body. It remains an inferred name rather than canonical spelling.
The signature, void return, subsystem side effects, and caller-restricted motion domain match. The helper does not validate that domain.
Directional entry and audiovisual initialization requests are explicit. Actual audible/visible realization and precise asset meanings remain deferred.
The proposed replacement correctly records ordered requests and normal-return assumptions instead of every-invocation success and unsupported recovery-sound or alternate-source labels.
Conditional forwarding of the same pointer and identity-based dispatch are verified. Neutral-action terminology is broad, as in the callee's comment, and does not assert universal ordinary idle.
The active F/B animation slots establish the completion role. Applicable neutral state is conditional dispatcher terminology; exact gameplay meanings of special destinations are not newly proved.
The exact callback signature is present in the definition and header, and the table uses it in the animation slot.
The callback does no local transition while the query is true and invokes the common completion dispatcher otherwise. Preservation is local, not a global state invariant.

The named boss branches, DownSpot and special early returns, conditional grounding, and Wait call are all present. The fact does not exclude subsequent optional processing documented in functionality.
The complete collision body forwards the same object without local transformation, and the active table confirms its callback role.
The neutral-tech interpretation is contradicted by the active separate Passive family. The proposed directional mapping and false-result Fall behavior are supported.
The void Fighter_GObj pointer signature is explicit.
The thin collision adapter purpose follows directly from the sole unconditional call.
There are no local guards, timers, or direct state decisions; the collision delegate can enter Fall.
The empty IASA body ignores its pointer and performs no data flow or side effect.
This callback supplies no input-based exit and is assigned to both directional recovery states. Global uninterruptibility is not claimed or established.
The exact signature and unused parameter are visible in the complete definition.
The inert IASA implementation is actively registered for both F/B states.
The no-op invariant is directly proved by the empty body; progression is not implemented in this callback.
The delegate's velocity, friction, walk-speed, multiplier, facing, flag and translation reads, followed by acceleration/friction alternatives and common movement, match the data-flow summary.

Multiplication alone does not establish stronger braking. The proposed write accurately preserves the strict guard and optional translation-derived acceleration branch without asserting configured magnitude.
The signature and active per-state physics slot are verified.
The callback unconditionally delegates to the shared friction-or-acceleration ground movement path.
Strict speed comparison, multiplier application, translation flag branch, and convergent ground movement are verified. Absence of timers and transitions is a local callback claim.
Input-to-motion selection, entry and subsequent callback registration are supported by the implementation and active table.
Forward/backward ground-tech mapping is corroborated by directional input, the active table and damage-collision recovery callers.
The complete unit supplies the directional gate, common entry and four lifecycle callbacks assigned to F/B.
The proposed TU summary correctly replaces universal ordinary-grounded completion with the actual conditional dispatcher destinations and retains the complete local lifecycle.
